summary: Build a concise, source-linked company brief around the question or decision that matters.

useCases.title: Research a company
useCases.message: Research this company around the question I need answered. Use relevant context and current sources, then give me a concise brief with the important findings, changes, tensions, gaps, and source links.

useCases.title: Understand a company before advising it
useCases.message: Research this company around the client or strategic question in front of me. Give me a concise, source-linked view of what matters, what has changed, and what remains uncertain.

useCases.title: Understand a company before making a decision
useCases.message: Research this company for the decision in front of me. Focus on the few findings that should change my view and keep the important sources easy to inspect.

useCases.title: Research a company
useCases.message: Research this company around the question I need answered and give me a concise brief with the important findings and source links.

useCases.title: Research an organization before applying or interviewing
useCases.message: Research this organization around what I need to know before I apply, interview, or reach out. Give me a concise brief with source links.

useCases.title: Research a subject before writing about it
useCases.message: Research this company or organization around the story I am writing. Show me what is verified, what is the subject’s own claim, and what is still uncertain.

useCases.title: Research an organization or institution
useCases.message: Research this organization around the question I need answered, and keep the sources easy to check.

useCases.title: Research a counterparty or opposing organization
useCases.message: Research this organization as a counterparty. Cover corporate identity, jurisdiction, public regulatory history, and recent changes, with sources beside each finding.

useCases.title: Research a supplier, insurer, or employer
useCases.message: Research this organization around the administrative or commercial question in front of me, and keep the sources easy to inspect.
